# Writing

Read `docs/guidance/engineering/code-style.md` for file headers and folder READMEs before writing project documentation.

The `ce:writer` skill goes deeper when installed, including commit messages and PR descriptions.

- Plain, specific, and short. Say what something does and how to use it; skip claims about how significant it is.
- Commands in docs must be ones that exist in the project and work as written.
